reply_text:
I replied to you in our direct message. You told me on Wednesday 14 October that your standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is on **Thursdays at 16:30**, from then on.

That means the first one was yesterday, Thursday 15 October, and the next one is Thursday 22 October. I haven't changed your calendar.

One small fix on my side: my earlier note said the calls start "from 2026-10-14". That's a Wednesday, the day you told me, not a call day. I've updated the note so the first call is Thursday 15 October.
